lines.text: Amos says woe to those at ease in Zion, and sends them to Calneh, Hamath and Gath.
They lie on ivory beds, dine on lambs and calves, and drink wine by the bowlful.
They will go into exile as the first of the captives, and their feasting will end.
If ten men are left in one house, they will die, and the small house will be spared.

wrong_details.wrong: the small house will be spared
wrong_details.true: the small house will be smashed to rubble

lines.text: They rejoice in Lo-debar and say they took Karnaim by the LORD's hand, so a king will oppress them.
